adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking.ts` builds `evt.destinationCalendar` by starting with the organizer/eventType calendar and then `push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` for other hosts. However, when persisting the booking it only connects `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` (the first calendar) to `booking.destinationCalendar` (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`). Later flows (e.g. `confirm.handler.ts`, Stripe/PayPal webhooks, reminder cron) rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) or `user.destinationCalendar`, wrapping it into a one-element array, so any additional host calendars collected for COLLECTIVE are lost for those flows. This is a correctness issue/inconsistency grounded in the shown code paths.
